==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am handed a thick yellow book. I am told that it is the 300th volume of a comic series about videogames. I am told that a character named Thursday is in the book.

The story is about Thursday realizing they are allergic to magic. Their mystical allergy leads to them being imprisoned in an intergalactic jail cell. The story sounds interesting, but I am actually more interested in another character named Friday.

Thursday and and Friday are twin sisters. Both have spiky hair and wear leather dresses with oversized sleeves with a miniskirt. Thursday has pink hair and a pink dress. 

Friday has purple hair and a purple dress. I flip and flip through the pages of the book, but I wake up before I can find Friday.
